opening.argument: The speaker guarantees substantial earnings after buying a product and ties passive income to needing a large number of people. Those promises frame the promotion of Be Happy 24/Bitclub, reinforced by claims of $4,049 in earnings and a $560 check. The invitation is concrete: viewers are directed to register in Bitclub Network. Together, the purchase guarantee, recruitment requirement and registration pathway establish the recruitment-based earning pitch: buy into participation, assemble a network and obtain the promised income. The case rests on that explicit connection between purchasing, recruitment and earnings, without claiming that any viewer actually paid or suffered a loss.
